title: The Annex Ledger
charge: Knowingly removing a civic record without authorization
briefing: Police found the North Annex ledger missing from its assigned shelf at the closing count. Archivist Neri Vale was assigned the last shift. Nobody in the opening report claims to have seen the ledger leave. Officers noted four places to follow up: the key cabinet, the closing-round hallway, the dry store, and the transfer desk.
private_truth: Neri took the ledger off its shelf before the closing count and delivered it to the dry store to protect it from a leak. Neri told the courier where it was going and signed the 19:08 handoff receipt. There was no recorded authorization for the move. The clerk also lent out the spare key that evening, giving someone else access to the room.

client.name: Neri Vale
client.greeting: I was on the last shift. The shelves were dripping again. You can ask me what happened, but please don't let them blame Mira.

client-move.text: I moved the ledger. I took it to the dry store and Lio wrote a receipt. I should have called Sen first.

client-pipe.text: The pipe above the shelves was dripping by dinner. Sen called maintenance. Check the transfer desk for the call log.

client-keys.text: I used my own key. I don't know who signed for the spare. Ask Mira or look at the key cabinet.

closing-inventory.title: Closing inventory
closing-inventory.text: The assigned ledger shelf was empty at the 19:00 closing count. Neri Vale was assigned the last shift.

key-register.title: Spare key register
key-register.text: The spare key was issued at 18:40. The return time is recorded as 18:55.

recovery-note.title: Dry store recovery note
recovery-note.text: Police recovered the intact annex ledger from the dry store the following morning.

handoff-receipt.title: Dry store handoff receipt
handoff-receipt.text: A ledger handoff at 19:08 is signed Neri Vale. The destination is the dry store.

clock-photo.title: Hallway clock photograph
clock-photo.text: The closing-round photograph shows the hallway clock at 19:05 and a trolley by the annex door.

transfer-register.title: Authorized transfers register
transfer-register.text: The certified annex register requires a signed entry for moving an official record. Its export shows no ledger transfer entry for the date in question.

maintenance-log.title: Maintenance call log
maintenance-log.text: A leaking pipe above the ledger shelves was reported at 18:42. The maintenance team was due the next morning.

mira.name: Mira Senn
mira.profile: The key clerk keeps the spare key register.
mira.motive: Worries the spare-key handoff will look careless. Saw Neri walk toward the stairs but never saw Neri leave the building.
mira.demeanor: Precise about written records. Hesitates when asked about what happened outside the desk.

mira-register.delivery: Mira straightens the edge of the register.
mira-register.text: I kept the spare key register and wrote the entries myself.

mira-return.text: The spare key was back at 18:55. I saw Neri head for the stairs a few minutes later and assumed Neri had left.

mira-heard.text: A clerk told me Neri had permission. That is why I did not call the supervisor.

direct.text: Who kept the spare key register?
Offer the spare key register.
When did the spare key come back?

cross.text: You did not watch the annex door after that, did you?

direct.text: What did another clerk tell you about Neri having permission?

ivo.name: Ivo Ren
ivo.profile: The caretaker passed the annex during closing.
ivo.motive: Wants to help. Only saw a pale coat and heard a trolley from the corner, so cannot identify who moved the ledger.
ivo.demeanor: Talks quickly and corrects their own assumptions when pressed.

ivo-coat.delivery: Ivo stops halfway through a confident nod.
ivo-coat.text: I saw a pale coat and heard a trolley. I could not see the person's face.

ivo-clock.text: I took the hallway photograph on my closing round.

direct.text: What did you see near the annex?
Offer the hallway clock photograph.

cross.text: You couldn't see the person's face, could you?

direct.text: You saw Neri take the ledger, didn't you?

cross.text: What is your favorite color for a winter coat?

lio.name: Lio Fen
lio.profile: The courier works at the dry store receiving desk.
lio.motive: Saw Neri at the receiving desk and witnessed the signature. Knows nothing firsthand about the annex door or transfer approvals.
lio.demeanor: Blunt in conversation. Careful with times and willing to put a receipt ahead of memory.

lio-receipt.text: I filled in the dry store receipt and watched Neri sign it.

lio-handoff.text: I saw Neri bring the annex ledger to the dry store. Neri said it was being put there for the night.

lio-confirmed-time.delivery: Lio taps the time on the receipt.
lio-confirmed-time.text: Looking at my receipt, Neri personally handed me the ledger at 19:08. The dry store desk is on the stair landing.

lio-unsure.text: I was at the receiving desk. I never saw who opened the annex door.

direct.text: Offer the closing inventory.
Who wrote and signed the receipt?
Offer the dry store handoff receipt.
What did you see at the handoff?
When did the handoff take place?
Offer the police recovery note.
Offer the certified transfers register.

cross.text: You never saw who opened the annex door, did you?
What did you personally see at the handoff?

direct.text: Why do you think Neri wanted to mislead the supervisor?

sen.name: Sen Tal
sen.profile: The annex supervisor signs official transfer approvals.
sen.motive: Checked the approvals personally and logged the leak. Wants the rules respected but feels responsible for the delayed repair.
sen.demeanor: Formal and clipped about procedure. More candid when the discussion turns to the leak.

sen-register.text: I checked our signed transfer register myself. There was no approved ledger move that evening.

sen-leak.text: I called maintenance at 18:42 about the pipe above the ledger shelves. I recorded the call myself.

direct.text: Offer the closing inventory.
Offer the police recovery note.
What did the transfer register show?
Offer the authorized transfers register.
What happened with the pipe?
Offer the maintenance call log.

cross.text: There was a leak above the shelves, correct?

direct.text: Offer the maintenance log before asking the witness about it.

elements.label: The ledger was removed from its assigned location

factors.label: Protecting the ledger from a documented leak
